title: One-cusped Dehn fillings of the sisters of the Whitehead and $6^2_2$ link complements
summary: In this article, we investigate the arithmeticity of the one-cusped Dehn fillings of the $(-2,3,8)$-pretzel link complement and of the Berge manifold, which respectively are the sisters of the Whitehead and $6^2_2$ link complements. We show that for each such one-cusped hyperbolic Dehn filling, the cusp field, the trace field and the invariant trace field coincide.
